HeelerVulnerabilityFindingVendorAttribut.description:
Heeler-specific fields.

Heeler reports three kinds of finding through one shape — dependency
vulnerabilities, SAST findings and leaked secrets — so which fields are
populated depends on the kind, and the descriptions below say which.

affected_package_name.description: Name of the vulnerable package. Dependency findings only.
affected_package_name.title: Affected Package Name

affected_package_version.description: Version of the package that is affected. Dependency findings only.
affected_package_version.title: Affected Package Version

cve_id.description: CVE the finding refers to, when Heeler names one. Null for findings with no CVE, which includes every secret and most SAST findings.
cve_id.title: Cve Id

cvss_score.description: CVSS base score. Reserved: the Heeler payloads Leen ingests do not carry a score today, so this is null in practice — read `severity` on the finding instead.
cvss_score.title: Cvss Score

cvss_vector.description: CVSS vector string. Reserved on the same terms as `cvss_score`, and null in practice.
cvss_vector.title: Cvss Vector

cwe_ids.description: CWE identifiers Heeler cross-references for the finding. SAST findings only.
cwe_ids.title: Cwe Ids

ecosystem.description: Language or ecosystem the finding was raised in — the detected language for secrets, and the language or rule category for SAST findings. Null on dependency findings.
ecosystem.title: Ecosystem

fixed_version.description: Version Heeler recommends upgrading to. Dependency findings only, and null when Heeler has no recommendation.
fixed_version.title: Fixed Version

service_id.description: ID of the Heeler service the finding belongs to. Set on dependency and SAST findings; null on secrets, which Heeler attributes to a repository rather than a service.
service_id.title: Service Id

service_name.description: Repository the finding was found in. Set on secrets only; null on dependency and SAST findings, which carry `service_id` instead.
service_name.title: Service Name

vendor.description: Always `HEELER`. Identifies which vendor's shape this object takes.
vendor.title: Vendor

get.description: Return a resource by its ID (Leen's UUID)

List vulnerability findings with keyset pagination and filtering options.

- **severity**: Filter by severity (comma-separated list, e.g., 'CRITICAL,HIGH')
- **state**: Filter by state (comma-separated list, e.g., 'OPEN,REOPENED')
- **has_fix**: Filter by whether a fix is available
- **reachability**: Filter by reachability rollup (comma-separated list, e.g., 'REACHABLE,POTENTIALLY_REACHABLE')
- **exploitable**: Filter by exploitability (true/false); findings with no vendor signal match neither
- **first_seen_since**: Filter by findings first seen after this date
- **last_seen_since**: Filter by findings last seen after this date
- **state_updated_since**: Filter by findings with state updated after this date
- **resourceId**: Filter by resource ID (comma-separated list)
- **ids**: Filter by finding IDs (comma-separated list of UUIDs, max 100)
